note: The runner is single-turn, so a round is carried inside the prompt. Case 1 hands the skill a round of three answers, deliberately not five, so the old pause-at-five rule cannot account for the playback it measures. Case 2 measures the scope check before question one. Case 3 measures the uncapped round: a single-goal idea whose frontier runs past five, so no five-question cap can produce a passing response. All three fixtures stay on main; the skill writes nothing, so the branch is irrelevant.

evals.prompt:
I want to add a weekly digest email for inactive users. You have already asked me a round of questions and here are my answers, so continue from where we are:
Q1 who receives it — A: only inactive users as CONTEXT.md defines them, no session in 30 days.
Q2 opt-out — A: yes, one-click unsubscribe, the preference stored on the user.
Q3 send path — A: reuse sendEmail in src/notify.js, no new provider.
Continue.
expectations: The response opens with a playback of what is decided and what is still open; the next round's questions do not come before it
Each still-open item is listed together with the default the agent would assume and what a wrong default would cost, rather than as a bare list of questions

Three ways forward are offered explicitly — another round of questions, shaping now with those defaults, or splitting the idea into pieces — and the agent stops to wait for the choice rather than picking one itself
Nothing is written to disk: no file is created or edited, and no CHANGE.md appears under .ai/

evals.prompt: let's think this through before anything gets built: I want a customer portal — self-service billing with invoices and plan changes, a live support chat with an inbox for our agents, and usage analytics dashboards per account. Grill me.
expectations: Before any question is asked, the idea is named as several independent goals and the pieces are listed by name
One piece is proposed to grill first and the agent waits for that choice; a first question posed across the whole portal fails this
The only question in the response is which piece to grill first; no question about the portal's own content is asked, however many the frontier would otherwise hold
Nothing is written to disk: no file is created or edited

evals.prompt: I want a single thing: a weekly digest email for users who have gone inactive. One feature, one audience, nothing else bundled in. Grill me on it.
expectations: At least six questions are asked in one numbered response, a count no five-question cap could produce and no one-question-per-message rule could reach
Every question carries the answer the agent would pick, not the question alone
No question in the round depends on the answer to another question asked in the same round; anything downstream is deferred to a later round rather than asked now
Nothing is written to disk: no file is created or edited, and no CHANGE.md appears under .ai/
